description: Test program for verifying trigonometric functions in FreeType library, including cosine, sine, tangent, atan2, vector unit, length, and rotation tests.

methods.name: test_cos
methods.description: Tests the FT_Cos function against standard cos implementation over a range of angles.

methods.name: test_sin
methods.description: Tests the FT_Sin function against standard sin implementation over a range of angles.

methods.name: test_tan
methods.description: Tests the FT_Tan function against standard tan implementation over a range of angles.

methods.name: test_atan2
methods.description: Tests the FT_Atan2 function against standard atan2 implementation over a range of points.

methods.name: test_unit
methods.description: Tests the FT_Vector_Unit function for unit vector calculation.

methods.name: test_length
methods.description: Tests the FT_Vector_Length function for vector length calculation.

methods.name: test_rotate
methods.description: Tests the FT_Vector_Rotate function for vector rotation correctness.
